- [ ] Official university/school/faculty/lab page

## Checklist

- [ ] JSON uses the compact schema in `docs/schema.md`
- [ ] URLs are raw URLs, not Markdown links
- [ ] `status` is either `active` or `nonactive`
- [ ] `last_checked` is updated
- [ ] No duplicate entry exists
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_catalog.py` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/build_stats.py --check` passes
